notes: Gear acquisition uses real reward/shop APIs with conditional synthetic victories, no theft or overkill income. Not full-run survival.

Weak: first improving loot choice, no shops. Typical: best proxy-scored loot and at most one improving affordable purchase per shop. Strong: best proxy-scored loot and up to six improving affordable purchases. No rerolls.
Policy labels describe acquisition effort, not guaranteed DPS order; gold-dependent builds may favor conserving gold.
Gear proxy is resolved weapon plus elemental damage, attack speed and crit, without scoring a validation enemy.
Representative progression uses cyclic secondary; C10 mixed extension covers all twelve ordered roles and three allocation families.
C10 budget37: family35/33/24 means splits35/2,33/4,24/13. Tavern unchanged.
